$comment: Tenant/experience configuration that drives what the SPA shows. Kept outside ./infra so it is easy to find and edit. The infra reads this file and projects these values onto the web App Service application settings. See ./config/TODO.md for the wiring task. NOTE: the backend mode (mock vs real iManage) is NOT set here — it is driven by the azd `IMANAGE_BACKEND_MODE` env / Bicep param so there is a single source of truth.
$fieldMapComment: Each entry maps one neutral SPA field to an iManage profile field (code + *_description pair). 'source' is the raw iManage column; the backend reads <source> for the id and <source>_description for the label. These match the mock dataset in src/mock_upstream/app/data.py (custom1=client, custom2=matter, custom3=practice area, custom4=jurisdiction).
